symbols.name: first space
symbols.meaning: The first of the two vector spaces being tensored.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $E\otimes G$ of two vector spaces $E$ and $G$ is a space of dimension $\dim E\cdot\dim G$ on which operators and bilinear forms of the two factors act factorwise.

symbols.name: second space
symbols.meaning: The second of the two vector spaces being tensored.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $E\otimes G$ of two vector spaces $E$ and $G$ is a space of dimension $\dim E\cdot\dim G$ on which operators and bilinear forms of the two factors act factorwise.

symbols.name: vector in E
symbols.meaning: A vector of the first space E.
symbols.quote: For vectors $\xi\in E$ and $\eta\in G$, the pure tensor $\xi\otimes\eta$ is defined by expanding bilinearly, so it is linear in $\xi$ and in $\eta$ separately.

symbols.name: vector in G
symbols.meaning: A vector of the second space G.
symbols.quote: For vectors $\xi\in E$ and $\eta\in G$, the pure tensor $\xi\otimes\eta$ is defined by expanding bilinearly, so it is linear in $\xi$ and in $\eta$ separately.

symbols.name: operator on E
symbols.meaning: A linear map from E to itself.
symbols.quote: For linear maps $\phi:E\to E$ and $\psi:G\to G$, the map $\phi\otimes\psi$ is the linear map with $(\phi\otimes\psi)(\xi\otimes\eta)=\phi(\xi)\otimes\psi(\eta)$.

symbols.name: operator on G
symbols.meaning: A linear map from G to itself.
symbols.quote: For linear maps $\phi:E\to E$ and $\psi:G\to G$, the map $\phi\otimes\psi$ is the linear map with $(\phi\otimes\psi)(\xi\otimes\eta)=\phi(\xi)\otimes\psi(\eta)$.
